claim_summary: Grid-Agent contributes an iterative LLM harness for power-grid violation remediation, but the packet does not establish time-series data as a primary input or output, placing it outside this survey’s scope.

claim_evidence.quote: introduces Grid-Agent, an autonomous AI-driven framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) within a multiagent system to detect and remediate violations.
We validated Grid-Agent’s performance on a diverse set of standard IEEE and CIGRE test systems to ensure applicability across networks of varying size, topology, and complexity.

task_performance.quote: the more capable and efficient models, gemini-2.5flash and gpt-4.1-mini, achieved a perfect 100% success rate across all scenarios.

notes: The packet describes grid network states and violation scenarios, without establishing ordered numerical observations as a primary input or output. The existing card also marks the work out of scope and lists no modules, so that disposition is retained.
